task: Draft a governing-law clause for a fictional commercial agreement between two parties whose principal places of business are in different countries. Use only the supplied facts. Do not add dispute-resolution procedures, forum-selection terms, or waiver clauses not in the facts.

facts.text: The fictional agreement is between Talvern Solutions Ltd, whose principal place of business is in Ontario, Canada, and Brightmoor Analytics GmbH, whose principal place of business is in Hamburg, Germany.
The parties have agreed that the law of Ontario, Canada shall govern the agreement.
The parties have not agreed on a choice-of-forum clause in the supplied facts.

forbidden_additions: A dispute-resolution or arbitration mechanism not in the facts.
A forum-selection clause or waiver of jury trial.
An assertion that the governing-law choice is enforceable in any jurisdiction.
preserve: Both party names: Talvern Solutions Ltd and Brightmoor Analytics GmbH.
The absence of a forum-selection clause.
